entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you're speaking with Diana at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
I just don't want it. There was an emergency, and I ended up in the hospital right after I got it.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope you're recovering well. Can I get your order number to pull up the details?
It's VF-881920. It's been one thing after another. My husband's military deployment got moved up, and then I had to deal with an unexpected surgery for my mother. The box has just been sitting there.
I understand, that sounds incredibly stressful. Thank you for the order number. I see it was delivered about 40 days ago. Let me just double-check our return policy for you... one moment.
Okay, I've got it. Actually, you're perfectly fine. Our return policy allows for returns up to 10 days after delivery. So you are unfortunately outside the window.
Really. So I didn't need to explain all that personal stuff. Fantastic.

I apologize, I just wanted to be thorough. But yes, no exception is needed. I've just processed the return authorization for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Do you have access to that?

Great. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can do for you?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. I truly hope things get easier for you and your family.
